messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Hydrochlorothiazide starts to work within 2 hours of a dose.
The peak effect occurs at about 4 hours.
The increase in urine output lasts for around 6 to 12 hours.
The medicine's overall action on the body can persist for up to 24 hours.
Lowering blood pressure takes longer than the fluid effect.
Your doctor will usually reassess your blood pressure after a few weeks rather than straight away.
Hydrochlorothiazide is well absorbed.
It is not broken down by the body.
It is cleared by the kidneys.
Most of a dose passes out unchanged in the urine.
Its half-life has been reported as 6 to 15 hours.
Its half-life means the time for blood levels to fall by half.
In people with kidney disease, levels in the blood are higher.
In people with kidney disease, Hydrochlorothiazide stays in the body longer.
Hydrochlorothiazide controls high blood pressure but does not cure it.
Keep taking it even if you feel well, because high blood pressure often causes no symptoms.
Triples: [["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has onset of action", "2 hours"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has peak effect", "4 hours"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has duration of effect", "6 to 12 hours"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has duration of action", "up to 24 hours"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has effect duration", "longer than fluid effect"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has administration instruction", "reassess blood pressure after a few weeks"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has absorption characteristic", "well absorbed"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has metabolism characteristic", "not broken down by the body"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has elimination pathway", "cleared by the kidneys"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has excretion characteristic", "most of a dose passes out unchanged in the urine"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has half life", "6 to 15 hours"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has definition", "time for blood levels to fall by half"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has effect in", "people with kidney disease"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has pharmacokinetic effect", "higher blood levels in people with kidney disease"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has pharmacokinetic effect", "stays in the body longer in people with kidney disease"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "treats", "high blood pressure"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has administration instruction", "keep taking it even if you feel well"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has administration instruction", "high blood pressure often causes no symptoms"]]
Relations: ["has absorption characteristic", "has administration instruction", "has definition", "has duration of action", "has duration of effect", "has effect duration", "has effect in", "has elimination pathway", "has excretion characteristic", "has half life", "has metabolism characteristic", "has onset of action", "has peak effect", "has pharmacokinetic effect", "treats"]
Answer:

completion:
has absorption characteristic: The subject drug is characterized by the absorption property specified by the object entity.  
has administration instruction: Patients taking the subject drug should follow the medical instruction specified by the object entity.  
has definition: The object entity provides a definition or explanation of the subject property.  
has duration of action: The subject drug's overall effect on the body lasts for the time specified by the object entity.  
has duration of effect: The subject drug's specific effect lasts for the time specified by the object entity.  
has effect duration: The subject drug's effect lasts for a duration that is relative to the object entity.  
has effect in: The subject drug has a specific effect or characteristic in the group of people specified by the object entity.  
has elimination pathway: The subject drug is eliminated from the body through the pathway specified by the object entity.  
has excretion characteristic: The subject drug is excreted from the body with the characteristic specified by the object entity.  
has half life: The subject drug has a half-life duration specified by the object entity.  
has metabolism characteristic: The subject drug is metabolized in the body with the characteristic specified by the object entity.  
has onset of action: The subject drug begins to take effect after the time specified by the object entity.  
has peak effect: The subject drug reaches its maximum effect after the time specified by the object entity.  
has pharmacokinetic effect: The subject drug exhibits a pharmacokinetic characteristic specified by the object entity.  
treats: The subject drug is used to manage or treat the medical condition specified by the object entity.
